title: SEA-LION Launch
summary: AI Singapore states that SEA-LION (Southeast Asian Languages in One Network), its family of open large language models developed to better represent Southeast Asia's diverse contexts, languages and cultures, launched in November 2023.
significance: A documented launch milestone for an open large-language-model family explicitly oriented toward Southeast Asian linguistic and cultural contexts.
